info.name: Palo Alto Networks Prisma Cloud CSPM API
info.description:
REST API for Prisma Cloud Security Posture Management providing programmatic access to cloud security monitoring across AWS, Azure, GCP, and Oracle Cloud. The API supports managing security alerts, compliance policies, cloud account onboarding, asset inventories, and resource queries using RQL (Resource Query Language). Authentication uses JWT tokens obtained from the /login endpoint with access key credentials. Tokens are valid for 10 minutes and must be refreshed for long-running operations.

Contact Support:
 Name: Palo Alto Networks Developer Support
